_comment: Deploy config for The Hooded 20 — Robinhood Chain mainnet 4663. Fund-holding contracts: get a review before deploy.
_adminNote: owner==backend wallet. If set and != deployer, the script transfers ownership of NFT/staking/pact to it and points penaltyRecipient at it. Deploy FROM this key to skip the transfer.

revenueSplitter._note: 90% -> staking pool (address derived at deploy), 10% -> owner/backend. IMMUTABLE — the script asserts poolBps and checksums owner before deploy.

freeMintAllowlist._note: owner test wallet — small free reserve for launch testing. Do NOT set near total supply: free mints bypass the cap and can PICK rares.

sherwoodPact._note: entry ~= $11 / refund ~= $5 in RH-ETH; set the ETH values via admin using the current price.
